svg.title: Mule deer movement prediction and geographic overlap

cc:Work.dc:title: Mule deer movement prediction and geographic overlap
cc:Work.dc:description: R scores log(1 + standardized 2 h displacement / 0.1 km). Solid: same-record anonymous-pool CRPS − personal CRPS; faint dashed: peer-only gain. Same-record audit added after inspecting primary outcomes. Both contrasts use full-month eligibility and both calendar-half holdout directions. R conditions on common 5 km × 6 h contexts. X is pair-date-balanced geographic occupancy overlap, not resource overlap or encounters. B–C use fixed annual cohorts conditional on year-round observation. C compares winter (Dec–Feb) and summer (Jun–Aug) within supported pairs. C requires ≥2 supported months per season; shading spans four grid origins, not CI. D uses same-record gain and X for the same monthly animals. One adult-female Sublette source over three years; survivor-conditioned cohorts, descriptive comparisons, no population CI or causal inference.
